turn_prompts: Derive a focused task design from the frozen repo_analysis and the selected Git source snapshot. Define the observable bug or feature, scope, public contract, constraints, and success criteria using only behavior supported by that source.
Design an independent solution and test strategy. Ensure a capable solver can implement it locally, while tests distinguish correct behavior from shallow or overfit implementations.
Produce the task_proposal artifact in the required structured output envelope. Include implementation boundaries, test plan, expected artifacts, and explicit non-goals.
